# Tech, Power, and the Struggle for American Democracy

[Shutterstock](https://www.shutterstock.com/image-photo/national-election-day-united-states-america-2454758109)

I celebrated the day with my family at the main branch of the New York Public Library, where we [viewed a copy](https://click.mlsend.com/link/c/YT0zMDQ2NjkxNjQzNDU4NTkwMjQ5JmM9ZzBhOCZlPTc3MDMxODgxJmI9MTU1Mjg5MDIxNCZkPWQxbjFoOXo=.g4gIm7KhbhvoZFTS_LGT5E5TVgyCIb_qGSj2ziI4Z-0) of the Declaration of Independence handwritten by **Thomas Jefferson**. It was one of the copies he sent to friends after July 4, 1776, to communicate how the final version adopted by the Second Continental Congress was different from his text. This version contained objections to the slave trade, even though Jefferson was, and would remain throughout his life, a slaveholder himself.

This July 4, like many of you, I find myself thinking about the trajectory of the struggle for American democracy. In its latest [democracy report](https://click.mlsend.com/link/c/YT0zMDQ2NjkxNjQzNDU4NTkwMjQ5JmM9ZzBhOCZlPTc3MDMxODgxJmI9MTU1Mjg5MDIxNSZkPXYwYjluN2E=.sa-RDgWUMVQ887yEBxK-uC7NxtnUckOhnbObpKLVMIM), the V-Dem Institute downgraded the US from the status of ‘liberal democracy’ to that of an ‘electoral democracy’ for the first time in 50 years. "Under Trump’s presidency, the level of democracy in the USA has fallen back to the same level as in 1965," V-Dem concludes. "Typically, autocratizing countries of the 'third wave' have taken about a decade to make such a deep dive, and the speed of decline is comparable to some coups d´états."

Figure 22 (V-Dem Institute Democracy Report 2026).

The question on this 250th year since the Declaration was signed is whether we can arrest this freefall, or whether it will continue. It seems unlikely any particular electoral outcome will magically stop the overall direction of travel, though elections may slow the rate of decline. Whether America remains an electoral democracy or can one day reclaim its status as a liberal democracy and be in a position to continue the struggle towards freedom and equality will depend, in part, on how we govern the relationship between technology and political power.

This is, of course, not just a question for the US, but for the world, and I’m grateful to all of you in the Tech Policy Press community who are working on it.

#### **Can Geneva deliver or is it just talk? The UN Global Dialogue on AI Governance**

Speaking of the community, many of you are en route or already in Geneva for the UN’s first [Global Dialogue on AI Governance](https://click.mlsend.com/link/c/YT0zMDQ2NjkxNjQzNDU4NTkwMjQ5JmM9ZzBhOCZlPTc3MDMxODgxJmI9MTU1Mjg5MDIxNyZkPWowZDR2MGQ=.5SZNUm2CvE-omkOgdMzalSqHwSYSlvD2wnXt5WdcJYo), which kicks off tomorrow. We had a number of pieces considering the prospects for the Dialogue and what it should try to accomplish:

- The UN is the only forum where every member country has an equal seat, write **Michael L. Bąk**, **Supheakmungkol Sarin**, and **Adrian Mak** of AI Safety Asia. But the Global Dialogue on AI must [produce architecture, not just principles](https://click.mlsend.com/link/c/YT0zMDQ2NjkxNjQzNDU4NTkwMjQ5JmM9ZzBhOCZlPTc3MDMxODgxJmI9MTU1Mjg5MDIxOCZkPXA5eDZyNWQ=.LrDLQsWscrMQz08Axbw1eWNkJxIK4RJYvE_d7ZsjoBw), they argue: “The Dialogue's value will not be measured in declarations. It will be measured in what gets built afterward, by whom, and for whom.”
- Ahead of the UN's first Global Dialogue on AI July 6–7 in Geneva, **Konstantinos Komaitis**, resident fellow at the Democracy and Tech Initiative at the Atlantic Council, argues the central question is how to [navigate the geopolitical moment](https://click.mlsend.com/link/c/YT0zMDQ2NjkxNjQzNDU4NTkwMjQ5JmM9ZzBhOCZlPTc3MDMxODgxJmI9MTU1Mjg5MDIxOSZkPW0wYTN6MmU=.dAmq566ZJ14RRk-hM5h-1bJZY-KZH_NXvWomyb9Yxfs): can nations still cooperate on AI amid increasing strategic competition?
- AI systems are "at their core, a technology of expression and access to information,” writes **Isabelle Anzabi**, research associate at The Future of Free Speech at Vanderbilt University. [How governments govern the technology](https://click.mlsend.com/link/c/YT0zMDQ2NjkxNjQzNDU4NTkwMjQ5JmM9ZzBhOCZlPTc3MDMxODgxJmI9MTU1Mjg5MDIyMCZkPWQzdTVrNWc=.ZOIG9Im505_1S1mSYDUQtPKmA_e_1pAWivq6tLZkFx8) will shape what people can say, seek, and know—and the UN Global Dialogue on AI Governance in Geneva is where Anzabi says the world can get that right.
- The UN Global Dialogue on AI Governance should tackle the [systemic disadvantage faced by users](https://click.mlsend.com/link/c/YT0zMDQ2NjkxNjQzNDU4NTkwMjQ5JmM9ZzBhOCZlPTc3MDMxODgxJmI9MTU1Mjg5MDIyMSZkPXI1YTVwOGU=.Wt8wRCwjPyqHdbBTJVJ3ZNm0gNbGu506bycsBmjaY8U) of AI systems in low-resource languages — a real need not being solved elsewhere, writes **Christian Schlaepfer,** a former Swiss diplomat and negotiator of tech and AI policy at the United Nations.
- “Geneva offers the governments, scientists, and civil society organizations gathered this week the opportunity to turn responsible AI from a catchphrase into a roadmap people can see, measure, and hold us to.” The UN's Scientific Panel on AI, which released its preliminary report last week, is designed to build an evidence base that policymakers must translate into action, writes **Rebecca Finlay**, CEO of the Partnership on AI. This mechanism will be crucial to addressing the [concerns of a wary public](https://click.mlsend.com/link/c/YT0zMDQ2NjkxNjQzNDU4NTkwMjQ5JmM9ZzBhOCZlPTc3MDMxODgxJmI9MTU1Mjg5MDIyMiZkPXAyeTRsOHo=.5UsmQvtMqrDgTcIU2BdZlQdBSV4HARX6J0SVhmUr9NQ), she says.
- Next week in Geneva, the inaugural UN Global Dialogue on AI Governance convenes alongside WSIS. **Jhalak Kakkar,** executive director at the Centre for Communication Governance, **Jason Pielemeier,** executive director at the Global Network Initiative (GNI), and **Elonnai Hickok,** GNI's managing director, argue the UN cannot afford to ignore two [decades of internet governance lessons](https://click.mlsend.com/link/c/YT0zMDQ2NjkxNjQzNDU4NTkwMjQ5JmM9ZzBhOCZlPTc3MDMxODgxJmI9MTU1Mjg5MDIyMyZkPXk4cjVuNGY=.D9-eQFgRODryvcSKjMEbf2zqOe6rnCVZ96VTos4vako).

#### **The children’s online safety debate continues**

- On Monday, the US House of Representatives passed the Kids Internet and Digital Safety (KIDS) Act, a sprawling collection of measures aimed at [mitigating online harms to minors](https://click.mlsend.com/link/c/YT0zMDQ2NjkxNjQzNDU4NTkwMjQ5JmM9ZzBhOCZlPTc3MDMxODgxJmI9MTU1Mjg5MDIyNCZkPXA1cjFsMGE=.Wn0dQPY9N4b7HxqOJ2JWBrEF8F_pixRwFAY_aFuTbko), in a 267-117 vote. The bill will now head to the Senate, where it reportedly faces long odds, writes **Tim Bernard**, a tech policy analyst and writer.
- “This idea of a ‘presumptive’ ban on social media — whereby platforms would be banned for teenagers *until and unless* they can demonstrate to a regulator or similar such body that they are safe — satiates the political appetite for access restrictions while recasting them as a lever for safety-by-design.” The [presumptive teen social media ban](https://click.mlsend.com/link/c/YT0zMDQ2NjkxNjQzNDU4NTkwMjQ5JmM9ZzBhOCZlPTc3MDMxODgxJmI9MTU1Mjg5MDIyNSZkPW44dzZ5MGE=.F0M2d1GOSISwecxQHG_0pTiKhk5v6CyFOYxOxuhbcgA) is gaining traction as the only viable alternative to a hard ban. But **Owen Bennett,** an independent tech policy expert, argues it's a proposal made for a regulatory world that doesn't yet exist.
- What is currently missing from the discussion is the hidden children's rights and human rights [cost of mandatory age assurance](https://click.mlsend.com/link/c/YT0zMDQ2NjkxNjQzNDU4NTkwMjQ5JmM9ZzBhOCZlPTc3MDMxODgxJmI9MTU1Mjg5MDIyNiZkPWM0ZzhvNmc=.Fc0CH9C4xsS2XGjurJ4YNVKdQN5oqNn2K5h1shJvGSA), write **Emma Day** and **Sabine Witting** of Tech Legality.

#### **EU tech sovereignty and the illusion of independence**

- [Europe's AI industrial strategy](https://click.mlsend.com/link/c/YT0zMDQ2NjkxNjQzNDU4NTkwMjQ5JmM9ZzBhOCZlPTc3MDMxODgxJmI9MTU1Mjg5MDIyNyZkPWgzZTV0NG8=.4yEp4VUGn2YkKLPRa1mhusUfxMT1T9nV74pWdjY0uuU) assumes cloud capacity and AI demand can be addressed separately. **Frederike Kaltheuner** and **Leevi Saari** of the AI Now Institute argue that framing misses how the two are structurally entangled. “AI sovereignty is not separate from the existing cloud market dynamics Europe has failed to grapple with. It is intricately connected in ways that simply boosting supply and demand separately can’t solve,” they write.
- Europe says it wants tech sovereignty, write **Cecilia Rikap** and **Vali Stan of** UCL’s Institute for Innovation and Public Purpose. But if the European Commission truly wants Europe to “act independently in the digital world”, they argue, it should start by freeing itself from [Big Tech’s epistemic capture](https://click.mlsend.com/link/c/YT0zMDQ2NjkxNjQzNDU4NTkwMjQ5JmM9ZzBhOCZlPTc3MDMxODgxJmI9MTU1Mjg5MDIyOCZkPWgxbTZsM2w=.3P-HtaWzU-b0STGWVBhmYfkbX4Ky1Wz5L56aXf8qjX4). This piece is part of our ongoing series on [Hype Studies](https://click.mlsend.com/link/c/YT0zMDQ2NjkxNjQzNDU4NTkwMjQ5JmM9ZzBhOCZlPTc3MDMxODgxJmI9MTU1Mjg5MDIyOSZkPWc4ZTdvMXc=.orHt7882Be2bosQCVNpyYIdGExw3QYKMoSZj8K6whfE).

#### Our content delivered to your inbox.

#### Thank you!

#### **AI, accountability, and drawing the line on data centers**

- The United States government may reject a company's terms. What it may not do, argues Loyola Law's **Simona Grossi** in this reflection of the Anthropic-Pentagon dispute, is "weaponize [the machinery of national security](https://click.mlsend.com/link/c/YT0zMDQ2NjkxNjQzNDU4NTkwMjQ5JmM9ZzBhOCZlPTc3MDMxODgxJmI9MTU1Mjg5MDIzMCZkPXQydjhuMHo=.-lBglkN1guSxkcIv3OLff9-qfOun9inmYAgp5xAy6hA) to destroy a business for holding a view on a matter of public importance."
- US communities are [winning fights against data centers](https://click.mlsend.com/link/c/YT0zMDQ2NjkxNjQzNDU4NTkwMjQ5JmM9ZzBhOCZlPTc3MDMxODgxJmI9MTU1Mjg5MDIzMSZkPXUyaDh0M2I=.EhYcPCT9DmDzPLLhsava1KSNjA2364Jc-MR9SVEFgW0) — but **Vignesh Ramachandran,** PhD candidate in Geography at the University of Wisconsin-Madison, and **Inayat Sabhikhi**, associate director of the Technology and Society Project at Bard College, warn that "stopping data centers in the US means little for the planet if they simply shift to Global Majority countries."
- June was marked by "an [unprecedented expansion of federal oversight](https://click.mlsend.com/link/c/YT0zMDQ2NjkxNjQzNDU4NTkwMjQ5JmM9ZzBhOCZlPTc3MDMxODgxJmI9MTU1Mjg5MDIzMiZkPXUwejJhOXg=.O2kDuzAtVAY7upDyZn6Uqt_v1iZxryL-TRLmzu9yRGU)over frontier AI," write **Rachel Lau, Shirley Frame**, and **Ben Lennett**—an executive order on model review, export controls on Anthropic, and limits on OpenAI's GPT-5.6 rollout. More in the June roundup from Freedman Consulting & Tech Policy Press.

#### **The courts weigh in**

- The United States Supreme Court just effectively gutted two key laws for [suing tech over human rights](https://click.mlsend.com/link/c/YT0zMDQ2NjkxNjQzNDU4NTkwMjQ5JmM9ZzBhOCZlPTc3MDMxODgxJmI9MTU1Mjg5MDIzMyZkPXc3bTJjMW8=.h0KOW0r2_xy9gZoetvtygSZrgyib8mbYNj1dtp3k3AM) abuses, says Tech Justice Law's **Madeline Batt**. The result in *Doe v. Cisco* leaves companies and executives "less constrained by liability fears"—and victims with fewer pathways to redress.
- DOGE fed grant descriptions into ChatGPT and rubber-stamped the outputs. A court said that's the government's own conduct — not the chatbot's. **Jordan Ascher** explains why the case, *American Council of Learned Societies v. National Endowment for the Humanities*, is a [landmark for AI accountability](https://click.mlsend.com/link/c/YT0zMDQ2NjkxNjQzNDU4NTkwMjQ5JmM9ZzBhOCZlPTc3MDMxODgxJmI9MTU1Mjg5MDIzNCZkPXE5YzN6NHA=.DygpohjvgOKpm74-tQ4Ij7mCj-7pLZSsp5ZzqMVj5uY).

#### **Navigating the current information environment**

- From Chile to Brazil to the US, elections are "[fertile ground for disinformation](https://click.mlsend.com/link/c/YT0zMDQ2NjkxNjQzNDU4NTkwMjQ5JmM9ZzBhOCZlPTc3MDMxODgxJmI9MTU1Mjg5MDIzNSZkPW41dTN6Mms=.Hw_PP3FWZTQB9aD9xPs04gay6xn3cQVohJgf6klvKv8)," write Amnesty International's **Marco Perolini** and **Daniel Joloy**. They make the case that fighting back requires far more than regulating platforms. “Supporting fact-checking, facilitating transparency and access to information, strengthening privacy protection frameworks, and investing in digital and media literacy are central to combating the use of disinformation as an authoritarian practice,” they write.
- Former FTC attorney-advisors **Gaurav Laroia** and **Charlotte Slaiman**argue that a massive public education campaign—a 'Truth Campaign' for the AI era—is needed to equip everyone with the knowledge and [means to live with AI](https://click.mlsend.com/link/c/YT0zMDQ2NjkxNjQzNDU4NTkwMjQ5JmM9ZzBhOCZlPTc3MDMxODgxJmI9MTU1Mjg5MDIzNiZkPXM3aThnMWw=.qKev-QhMoQ5CS1Bcau_u4njMOsPKBEHKQ4Fu4IWzm7I).

#### **On AI agents**

- **Camille Stewart Gloster**, the CEO of CAS Strategies, LLC and the former Deputy National Cyber Director for Technology & Ecosystem Security for The White House, **Numa Dhamani,** an engineer and researcher working at the intersection of technology and society, **Maggie Engler,** who fights platform manipulation at Twitter, and **Leah Ferentinos,** an AI Governance Researcher and Strategic Advisor to All Tech is Human, argue that capable agents won't be enough. [Winners in the 'agent economy'](https://click.mlsend.com/link/c/YT0zMDQ2NjkxNjQzNDU4NTkwMjQ5JmM9ZzBhOCZlPTc3MDMxODgxJmI9MTU1Mjg5MDIzNyZkPWoyajF1MmU=.q5RYFqwEPrF-Aq_UKtKIjbQVjJ8_lpT5u-oGL7KWv9Q) will build agents that act in customers' interests, navigate autonomy responsibly, and remain accountable when decisions affect real people.

#### **What we’re watching**

Missed last month's discussion with **Brandi Geurkink**, **Courtney Radsch, PhD**, and **Mark Scott** on barriers to data access and threats facing independent tech researchers? You can watch it [here](https://click.mlsend.com/link/c/YT0zMDQ2NjkxNjQzNDU4NTkwMjQ5JmM9ZzBhOCZlPTc3MDMxODgxJmI9MTU1Mjg5MDIzOCZkPWwxeTdoN2I=.0Gd4qiszis_hnD-vEmGm7ubBNgoj6UNHcB2pDtHGmLM). Plus, stay tuned for the next season of the "Digital Governance for Democratic Renewal" webinar series, returning in the fall. In partnership with **Columbia World Projects** and the **Centre for Digital Governance**, we'll continue exploring how to redesign the digital world to strengthen democracy with leading researchers, technologists, and civil society advocates.

We’ll be watching the outcomes of the UN dialogue this week, as well as whether the Trump administration will release [new guidance on AI safety standards](https://click.mlsend.com/link/c/YT0zMDQ2NjkxNjQzNDU4NTkwMjQ5JmM9ZzBhOCZlPTc3MDMxODgxJmI9MTU1Mjg5MDIzOSZkPWM2dTV6NGk=.wjHWXH9skuzs6av-xVPT7ttVDraba4TZH3mAoDUmsQQ). We [invite contributions](https://click.mlsend.com/link/c/YT0zMDQ2NjkxNjQzNDU4NTkwMjQ5JmM9ZzBhOCZlPTc3MDMxODgxJmI9MTU1Mjg5MDI0MCZkPWowczZ4NXA=.zDVz6TMLvpkzcvOyid7ao8Tc_I0ijMAZVuPRzy1j5_c) on these issues and more.

I wish you all the best for the week ahead! - Justin

今年 7 月 4 日，和你們許多人一樣，我發現自己一直在思考美國民主奮鬥的走向。在最新的[民主報告](https://click.mlsend.com/link/c/YT0zMDQ2NjkxNjQzNDU4NTkwMjQ5JmM9ZzBhOCZlPTc3MDMxODgxJmI9MTU1Mjg5MDIxNSZkPXYwYjluN2E=.sa-RDgWUMVQ887yEBxK-uC7NxtnUckOhnbObpKLVMIM)中，V-Dem Institute 50 年來首次將美國從「自由民主」降級為「選舉民主」。V-Dem 總結道：「在川普總統任內，美國的民主程度已經倒退到 1965 年的同一水準。」它也指出：「通常，『第三波』中的威權化國家，大約需要十年才會出現如此深幅的下滑，而這種衰退速度可與某些政變相比。」

圖 22（V-Dem Institute 民主報告 2026）。

在《獨立宣言》簽署 250 週年的此刻，問題在於我們是否能止住這場急墜，或者它是否會繼續下去。任何特定的選舉結果，似乎都不太可能神奇地扭轉整體走向，雖然選舉或許能減緩衰退的速度。美國是否仍會維持選舉民主，或者有朝一日能重新取回自由民主的地位，並處於能夠繼續朝自由與平等奮鬥的位置，部分將取決於我們如何治理科技與政治權力之間的關係。

當然，這不只是美國的問題，也是全世界的問題；我很感謝 Tech Policy Press 社群中所有正在投入這項工作的你們。

#### **日內瓦能拿出成果，還是只是空談？聯合國 AI 治理全球對話**

說到這個社群，你們當中有許多人正在前往日內瓦，或已經抵達，準備參加聯合國首屆 [AI 治理全球對話](https://click.mlsend.com/link/c/YT0zMDQ2NjkxNjQzNDU4NTkwMjQ5JmM9ZzBhOCZlPTc3MDMxODgxJmI9MTU1Mjg5MDIxNyZkPWowZDR2MGQ=.5SZNUm2CvE-omkOgdMzalSqHwSYSlvD2wnXt5WdcJYo)，活動將於明天登場。我們刊出了幾篇文章，探討這場對話的前景，以及它應該努力達成的目標：

Bąk**、**Supheakmungkol Sarin** 與 **Adrian Mak** 寫道。但他們主張，AI 全球對話必須[產出架構，而不只是原則](https://click.mlsend.com/link/c/YT0zMDQ2NjkxNjQzNDU4NTkwMjQ5JmM9ZzBhOCZlPTc3MDMxODgxJmI9MTU1Mjg5MDIxOCZkPXA5eDZyNWQ=.LrDLQsWscrMQz08Axbw1eWNkJxIK4RJYvE_d7ZsjoBw)：「這場對話的價值不會用宣言來衡量，而會用之後建成了什麼、由誰來建、又是為誰而建來衡量。」

- 在聯合國首屆 AI 全球對話於 7 月 6 至 7 日在日內瓦舉行前，大西洋理事會（Atlantic Council）民主與科技倡議（Democracy and Tech Initiative）常駐研究員 **Konstantinos Komaitis** 主張，核心問題在於如何[因應當前的地緣政治時刻](https://click.mlsend.com/link/c/YT0zMDQ2NjkxNjQzNDU4NTkwMjQ5JmM9ZzBhOCZlPTc3MDMxODgxJmI9MTU1Mjg5MDIxOSZkPW0wYTN6MmU=.dAmq566ZJ14RRk-hM5h-1bJZY-KZH_NXvWomyb9Yxfs)：在戰略競爭日益升高之際，各國是否仍能在 AI 議題上合作？

- AI 系統「本質上是一種表達與取得資訊的技術」，范德堡大學（Vanderbilt University）The Future of Free Speech 研究員 **Isabelle Anzabi** 寫道。[各國政府如何治理這項技術](https://click.mlsend.com/link/c/YT0zMDQ2NjkxNjQzNDU4NTkwMjQ5JmM9ZzBhOCZlPTc3MDMxODgxJmI9MTU1Mjg5MDIyMCZkPWQzdTVrNWc=.ZOIG9Im505_1S1mSYDUQtPKmA_e_1pAWivq6tLZkFx8)，將形塑人們能說什麼、尋找什麼、知道什麼；而 Anzabi 認為，在日內瓦舉行的聯合國 AI 治理全球對話，正是世界可以把這件事做對的地方。

- 聯合國 AI 治理全球對話應處理低資源語言的 [AI 系統使用者所面臨的系統性不利處境](https://click.mlsend.com/link/c/YT0zMDQ2NjkxNjQzNDU4NTkwMjQ5JmM9ZzBhOCZlPTc3MDMxODgxJmI9MTU1Mjg5MDIyMSZkPXI1YTVwOGU=.Wt8wRCwjPyqHdbBTJVJ3ZNm0gNbGu506bycsBmjaY8U)。這是真實存在、且其他地方尚未解決的需求，前瑞士外交官、曾在聯合國參與科技與 AI 政策談判的 **Christian Schlaepfer** 寫道。

- 「日內瓦為本週齊聚於此的各國政府、科學家與公民社會組織，提供了一個機會：把負責任 AI 從一句口號，轉化為人們看得見、可衡量，並能據以要求我們負責的路線圖。」Partnership on AI 執行長 **Rebecca Finlay** 寫道，聯合國 AI 科學小組上週發布初步報告，其設計目標是建立證據基礎，讓政策制定者必須將其轉化為行動。她表示，這項機制將是回應[對 AI 保持戒心的公眾疑慮](https://click.mlsend.com/link/c/YT0zMDQ2NjkxNjQzNDU4NTkwMjQ5JmM9ZzBhOCZlPTc3MDMxODgxJmI9MTU1Mjg5MDIyMiZkPXAyeTRsOHo=.5UsmQvtMqrDgTcIU2BdZlQdBSV4HARX6J0SVhmUr9NQ)的關鍵。

#### **兒少網路安全的辯論仍在持續**

- 週一，美國眾議院以 267 票贊成、117 票反對通過《兒童網路與數位安全法案》（Kids Internet and Digital Safety, KIDS Act）。這是一套範圍廣泛的措施，旨在[減輕未成年人在網路上遭受的傷害](https://click.mlsend.com/link/c/YT0zMDQ2NjkxNjQzNDU4NTkwMjQ5JmM9ZzBhOCZlPTc3MDMxODgxJmI9MTU1Mjg5MDIyNCZkPXA1cjFsMGE=.Wn0dQPY9N4b7HxqOJ2JWBrEF8F_pixRwFAY_aFuTbko)。科技政策分析師兼作者 **Tim Bernard** 寫道，該法案接下來將送交參議院，但據報過關機率不高。
- 「這種社群媒體『推定式』禁令的構想，是指平台會被禁止向青少年開放，*除非且直到*它們能向監管機關或類似機構證明自身是安全的；這既滿足了政治上對存取限制的需求，同時又把這些限制重新包裝成推動安全設計的槓桿。」[青少年社群媒體推定式禁令](https://click.mlsend.com/link/c/YT0zMDQ2NjkxNjQzNDU4NTkwMjQ5JmM9ZzBhOCZlPTc3MDMxODgxJmI9MTU1Mjg5MDIyNSZkPW44dzZ5MGE=.F0M2d1GOSISwecxQHG_0pTiKhk5v6CyFOYxOxuhbcgA)正逐漸被視為硬性禁令之外唯一可行的替代方案。但獨立科技政策專家 **Owen Bennett** 主張，這個提案是為一個尚不存在的監管世界所設計。
- Tech Legality 的 **Emma Day** 與 **Sabine Witting** 寫道，目前討論中缺少的是[強制年齡確認](https://click.mlsend.com/link/c/YT0zMDQ2NjkxNjQzNDU4NTkwMjQ5JmM9ZzBhOCZlPTc3MDMxODgxJmI9MTU1Mjg5MDIyNiZkPWM0ZzhvNmc=.Fc0CH9C4xsS2XGjurJ4YNVKdQN5oqNn2K5h1shJvGSA)背後隱藏的兒童權利與人權代價。

#### **歐盟科技主權與獨立自主的幻象**

- [歐洲的 AI 產業策略](https://click.mlsend.com/link/c/YT0zMDQ2NjkxNjQzNDU4NTkwMjQ5JmM9ZzBhOCZlPTc3MDMxODgxJmI9MTU1Mjg5MDIyNyZkPWgzZTV0NG8=.4yEp4VUGn2YkKLPRa1mhusUfxMT1T9nV74pWdjY0uuU)假設雲端容量與 AI 需求可以分開處理。AI Now Institute 的 **Frederike Kaltheuner** 與 **Leevi Saari** 主張，這樣的框架忽略了兩者在結構上如何交織在一起。「AI 主權並不是和歐洲一直未能正視的既有雲端市場動態分開的。兩者之間有著錯綜複雜的連結，單純分別拉抬供給與需求無法解決這個問題，」他們寫道。

#### **AI、問責，以及為資料中心劃出界線**

- **Rachel Lau、Shirley Frame** 與 **Ben Lennett** 寫道，六月的特徵是「聯邦政府對前沿 AI 的監督出現[前所未有的擴張](https://click.mlsend.com/link/c/YT0zMDQ2NjkxNjQzNDU4NTkwMjQ5JmM9ZzBhOCZlPTc3MDMxODgxJmI9MTU1Mjg5MDIzMiZkPXUwejJhOXg=.O2kDuzAtVAY7upDyZn6Uqt_v1iZxryL-TRLmzu9yRGU)」：包括針對模型審查的行政命令、對 Anthropic 的出口管制，以及限制 OpenAI 的 GPT-5.6 推出。更多內容見 Freedman Consulting 與 Tech Policy Press 的六月彙整。

我和家人在紐約公共圖書館總館慶祝這一天；我們在那裡[看了一份](https://click.mlsend.com/link/c/YT0zMDQ2NjkxNjQzNDU4NTkwMjQ5JmM9ZzBhOCZlPTc3MDMxODgxJmI9MTU1Mjg5MDIxNCZkPWQxbjFoOXo=.g4gIm7KhbhvoZFTS_LGT5E5TVgyCIb_qGSj2ziI4Z-0)由**湯瑪斯・傑佛遜（Thomas Jefferson）**親手書寫的《獨立宣言》副本。這是他在 1776 年 7 月 4 日之後寄給朋友的副本之一，用來說明第二次大陸會議通過的最終版本，與他原本的文本有何不同。這個版本包含了對奴隸貿易的反對意見，儘管傑佛遜本人當時是奴隸主，而且終其一生都是如此。

今年 7 月 4 日，和你們許多人一樣，我發現自己一直在思考美國民主奮鬥的走向。在最新的[民主報告](https://click.mlsend.com/link/c/YT0zMDQ2NjkxNjQzNDU4NTkwMjQ5JmM9ZzBhOCZlPTc3MDMxODgxJmI9MTU1Mjg5MDIxNSZkPXYwYjluN2E=.sa-RDgWUMVQ887yEBxK-uC7NxtnUckOhnbObpKLVMIM)中，V-Dem Institute 50 年來首次將美國從「自由民主」降級為「選舉民主」。V-Dem 總結道：「在川普總統任內，美國的民主程度已經倒退到 1965 年的同一水準。」它也指出：「通常，『第三波』中的威權化國家，大約需要十年才會出現如此深幅的下滑，而這種衰退速度可與某些政變相比。」

圖 22（V-Dem Institute 民主報告 2026）。

在《獨立宣言》簽署 250 週年的此刻，問題在於我們是否能止住這場急墜，或者它是否會繼續下去。任何特定的選舉結果，似乎都不太可能神奇地扭轉整體走向，雖然選舉或許能減緩衰退的速度。美國是否仍會維持選舉民主，或者有朝一日能重新取回自由民主的地位，並處於能夠繼續朝自由與平等奮鬥的位置，部分將取決於我們如何治理科技與政治權力之間的關係。

當然，這不只是美國的問題，也是全世界的問題；我很感謝 Tech Policy Press 社群中所有正在投入這項工作的你們。

#### **兒少網路安全的辯論仍在持續**

- 週一，美國眾議院以 267 票贊成、117 票反對通過《兒童網路與數位安全法案》（Kids Internet and Digital Safety, KIDS Act）。這是一套範圍廣泛的措施，旨在[減輕未成年人在網路上遭受的傷害](https://click.mlsend.com/link/c/YT0zMDQ2NjkxNjQzNDU4NTkwMjQ5JmM9ZzBhOCZlPTc3MDMxODgxJmI9MTU1Mjg5MDIyNCZkPXA1cjFsMGE=.Wn0dQPY9N4b7HxqOJ2JWBrEF8F_pixRwFAY_aFuTbko)。科技政策分析師兼作者 **Tim Bernard** 寫道，該法案接下來將送交參議院，但據報過關機率不高。
- 「這種社群媒體『推定式』禁令的構想，是指平台會被禁止向青少年開放，*除非且直到*它們能向監管機關或類似機構證明自身是安全的；這既滿足了政治上對存取限制的需求，同時又把這些限制重新包裝成推動安全設計的槓桿。」[青少年社群媒體推定式禁令](https://click.mlsend.com/link/c/YT0zMDQ2NjkxNjQzNDU4NTkwMjQ5JmM9ZzBhOCZlPTc3MDMxODgxJmI9MTU1Mjg5MDIyNSZkPW44dzZ5MGE=.F0M2d1GOSISwecxQHG_0pTiKhk5v6CyFOYxOxuhbcgA)正逐漸被視為硬性禁令之外唯一可行的替代方案。但獨立科技政策專家 **Owen Bennett** 主張，這個提案是為一個尚不存在的監管世界所設計。
- Tech Legality 的 **Emma Day** 與 **Sabine Witting** 寫道，目前討論中缺少的是[強制年齡確認](https://click.mlsend.com/link/c/YT0zMDQ2NjkxNjQzNDU4NTkwMjQ5JmM9ZzBhOCZlPTc3MDMxODgxJmI9MTU1Mjg5MDIyNiZkPWM0ZzhvNmc=.Fc0CH9C4xsS2XGjurJ4YNVKdQN5oqNn2K5h1shJvGSA)背後隱藏的兒童權利與人權代價。

#### **歐盟科技主權與獨立自主的幻象**

#### **AI、問責，以及為資料中心劃出界線**

- 美國政府可以拒絕一家公司的條款。但洛約拉法學院的 **Simona Grossi** 在這篇對 Anthropic 與五角大廈爭議的反思中主張，政府不能「把[國家安全機器](https://click.mlsend.com/link/c/YT0zMDQ2NjkxNjQzNDU4NTkwMjQ5JmM9ZzBhOCZlPTc3MDMxODgxJmI9MTU1Mjg5MDIzMCZkPXQydjhuMHo=.-lBglkN1guSxkcIv3OLff9-qfOun9inmYAgp5xAy6hA)武器化，只因一家公司對公共重要議題持有某種觀點，就摧毀其業務」。
- 美國各地社群正在[贏得對抗資料中心的戰役](https://click.mlsend.com/link/c/YT0zMDQ2NjkxNjQzNDU4NTkwMjQ5JmM9ZzBhOCZlPTc3MDMxODgxJmI9MTU1Mjg5MDIzMSZkPXUyaDh0M2I=.EhYcPCT9DmDzPLLhsava1KSNjA2364Jc-MR9SVEFgW0)，但威斯康辛大學麥迪遜分校地理學博士候選人 **Vignesh Ramachandran**，以及巴德學院（Bard College）科技與社會計畫副主任 **Inayat Sabhikhi** 警告：「如果資料中心只是轉移到全球多數國家（Global Majority countries），那麼在美國阻止資料中心，對地球而言意義不大。」
